Radio · Panel · The panel, 10.1"

Picks of 14 November: 1b favourites first · 2a the library’s row · 3b move on the selected row · 4 search · 5a / 9a a Radio button beside Settings · 6c Minimise returns to Radio · 7b the heart beside the title · 8a category tiles, then two rows · 11a Remote · Radio · Settings · 12b favourites first · 13 the phone’s flows. A station row reveals on the first tap; only Play plays. Stations, logos, counts and addresses are invented.

From the library’s Radio card with Lyrion on, from the waiting screen with Lyrion off or Navigation Off (no Lyrion’s radio there). With Lyrion off the mini strip comes back on Radio while something plays: it is the way to Now Playing from here.

Radio · Panel · The panel, 10.1"

Picks of 14 November: 1b favourites first · 2a the library’s row · 3b move on the selected row · 4 search · 5a / 9a a Radio button beside Settings · 6c Minimise returns to Radio · 7b the heart beside the title · 8a category tiles, then two rows · 11a Remote · Radio · Settings · 12b favourites first · 13 the phone’s flows. A station row reveals on the first tap; only Play plays. Stations, logos, counts and addresses are invented.
